The FOUR reverse-scored columns QCAE1r, QCAE2r, QCAE17r and QCAE29r carry NO variable label and no value labels -- they are the authors' reverse-recoded versions of QCAE items 1, 2, 17 and 29 (the same four the sibling deposit queiros_2018_qcae ships as QCAE_1_R/2_R/17_R/29_R), so their wording was taken from the canonical QCAE (Reniers et al. 2011, J Pers Assess 93(1):84-95) keyed by item number, transcribed from the EMERGE/UCSD reproduction (emerge.ucsd.edu/r_3punmrvubfwa4xc/), which prints all 31 items and marks the four reverse-scored ones. mapping_basis is therefore recorded as paper_explicit rather than data_labels -- the conservative of the two -- and Step 5b was done rather than claimed exempt. WHICH REVERSE ITEM IS WHICH: EMERGE lists items in subscale-grouped order, not Reniers' original numbering, so the four wordings had to be keyed back to numbers 1/2/17/29. Queiros et al. (2018, PLOS ONE 13(6):e0197755, CC BY) name item 17 by number and print it -- 'item 17 from the peripheral responsivity subscale ("It is hard for me to see why some things upset people so much")' -- and add that 'the three remaining items that compose this subscale (items 2, 11 and 29) address emotional responses to social contexts that are detached to the subject, such as narrative works of art (movies, plays, novels)'. That fixes 17, and the data agree: QCAE17r has by far the weakest PER item-rest correlation (+0.219 vs +0.568/+0.521/+0.609) and correlates only +0.145..+0.221 with the three narrative items, matching the loading of .29 this paper itself reports for item 17. QCAE1r correlates +0.542 with the Online Simulation rest but only +0.172 with PER, so it is the single reverse-worded OS item ('I sometimes find it difficult to see things from the "other guy's" point of view.'). NOT ESTABLISHED BY DATA: QCAE2r vs QCAE29r, the two remaining narrative PER items -- item-rest +0.568 vs +0.609, mutual r +0.573, and no published quantity is keyed to their text. Their assignment rests on Reniers' documented item sourcing (items 1-6 from the IRI, whose reverse Fantasy item is 'I am usually objective when I watch a film or play...'; items 15-29 from the Empathy Quotient, which supplies 'I usually stay emotionally detached when watching a film.').
